candidate_workaround: Use ripgrep file discovery or an exact LiteralPath instead of passing a PowerShell wildcard as a literal ripgrep path.
failure_signature: A Windows wildcard path is passed directly to ripgrep and is rejected as an invalid filename.
recurrence_guard: Discover files with rg --files and filter them, or inspect an exact file with LiteralPath.
rollback: Give the failed wildcard command zero evidence credit and rerun an exact bounded file probe.
scope_boundary: Local file discovery only; no content or authority claim.
title: Windows-safe exact-path inspection
trigger_preconditions: A local inspection command would pass a wildcard path directly to a cross-platform executable.
